headline: At least 27 killed in Bangkok pub fire
summary: The blaze broke out at the Rong Beer Na Lat Phrao pub in the Chatuchak district, marking one of the deadliest incidents in the city's tourism hub in recent years.
details: At least 27 people have been killed in a devastating fire at a pub in Bangkok, Thailand. The incident is described as one of the deadliest such occurrences in the tourism hub in recent years.
The fire broke out at the Rong Beer Na Lat Phrao pub, located in the Chatuchak district of the capital city.
Anwut Pho-ampai of the Ruamkatanyu Foundation, a voluntary emergency rescue service, confirmed that the death toll has exceeded 27 people.
Thailand's Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul stated that the cause of the fire is currently under investigation.
Local media reports have provided initial details, while authorities continue to work on determining exactly how the fire started.
caption:

Anwut Pho-ampai of the Ruamkatanyu Foundation, a voluntary emergency rescue service, confirmed that the death toll has exceeded 27 people.

Thailand's Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul stated that the cause of the fire is currently under investigation.

Local media reports have provided initial details, while authorities continue to work on determining exactly how the fire started.

headline: 60 kmph winds, very heavy rain in 5 divisions by morning
summary: Severe weather alerts issued as strong winds and intense rainfall are expected to hit multiple regions of Bangladesh.
details: Storms with wind speeds of up to 60 kmph are expected to hit several parts of the country by morning.
Very heavy rainfall is forecasted for five divisions of Bangladesh, raising concerns about potential flooding and disruptions.
Authorities have issued warnings for specific areas where heavy rain is expected to continue through the night and into the early morning hours.
Residents in the affected divisions are advised to take necessary precautions against the strong winds and intense rainfall.
